answer: Locks are entered in harbor, expire in mirror, and kernel lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 58 aliases hence needs 169 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 13 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1802 identities would post 3403 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
